why_that_is_not_vacuous: A clean report reads identically to a report over zero checks, which is the
failure AD6_PLAN.md 9.34.3 records. Three things rule it out here: the
denominator above was counted on disk after the run wrote it;
`bench/compliance_checker.py` was handed that path and exited 0, and
`generic_benchmark._compliance` raises on a non-zero exit precisely so an
ABORTED checker cannot be mistaken for one that found nothing; and
test_wl_up_policy_artifacts.py passes 6/6 against the files this run wrote,
so the benchmark's regeneration agrees with gen_wl_up_inputs.sh.
